title: introduce-prefetchor-adaptive-cost-agent-and-tenant-warmstart
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add Prefetchor adaptive cost agent which performs tenant-aware warmstart profiling, suggests batching and quantization defaults, and exposes a safe roll-forward policy. Includes telemetry, ops runbook, and opt-in console controls. No breaking changes to public API. Recommend canary rollout to 5% of traffic for first week.
description: Context: recurring customer feedback and internal unit-econ experiments showed that many tenants would benefit from an automated prefetch and warmstart agent that can synthesize tenant-level batching and quantization defaults without manual tuning. This PR introduces Prefetchor, an adaptive cost agent that runs lightweight background sampling, builds a short-term workload signature, and proposes warmstart batch/cache presets and quant profiles scoped per-tenant. Motivation: reduce first-byte high-token cost spikes, lower cold-run latency, and provide safe automated defaults that improve unit economics with minimal operator effort. What changed: new service under services/econ-agent/prefetchor with a small state machine for sampling, a profile synthesis module that maps sample signatures to recommended batch sizes and quant profiles, a tenant policy engine that enforces SLOs and cost budgets, console UI for opt-in controls and a one-click profile apply, a telemetry bridge for cost/latency delta tracking, and an ops runbook for rollback and incident playbooks. Safety: recommendations are applied as a non-invasive shadow first; an auto-apply mode is tenant-opt-in and bounded by guardrails (max token savings threshold, min latency delta, fallback model variant mapping). Rollout plan: canary on dedicated staging tenants then 5% production traffic for two weeks with telemetry gates. Testing: unit tests for sampler and profile synthesizer, integration test that simulates cold-to-warm transitions, load-smoke that verifies batching benefits across sequence length distributions. Backwards compatibility: does not change serving API or model variants. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-2769 - [x] unit/integration tests added - [x] telemetry metrics and dashboards scaffolding - [x] ops runbook and rollback instructions - [x] console feature flag and RBAC gating - [x] staged canary and kill-switch implemented TL;DR: introduces Prefetchor agent to automate warmstart and cost defaults per tenant while preserving safety and observability.

review_comments: Diego: Please add a short explanation of the sampling budget calculation and ensure it can't exceed tenant rate limits. Maya: Added sampling budget limiter in policy.py and unit tests to validate budget enforcement.

Asha: We should make the default auto-apply off for enterprise tenants until we get two weeks of telemetry. Maya: Agreed, default is opt-in; console flag is disabled for enterprise by default and documented in admin guide.

Lena: CI flaked on integration test under heavy load; can we split the long-running load simulation into a separate job? Maya: Split integration load into an optional e2e job and added a smoke variant for CI to keep main pipeline fast.
